svg.title: Multi-region platform
svg.desc: A global load balancer sends traffic to region A, with region B on standby. Each region runs a cluster of services and its own database, kept in sync by replication. Three scenarios: a checkout request, a region failover and a rolling deploy.

g.aria-label: Fail region A: play Region failover

svg.text: The customer's browser sends the order to the global load balancer.
Region A is active, so the load balancer sends the request there.
The checkout API asks the pricing service for the total, then queues the order for the workers.
A worker writes the order to the primary database.
The write is replicated to region B, which stays ready to take over.
